LS-01.title: WhatsApp QR code was not a valid QR code (finder patterns corrupted by masking bug)
LS-01.notes: Rewrote templates/local-service/script.js's QR encoder from scratch: proper reserved-cell tracking (finder/timing/alignment/dark-module/format-info/version-info), version-info support for v7-10 (the default preset's own WhatsApp message already needs v8), and adaptive mask-penalty scoring (ISO 18004) instead of a hardcoded mask. Verified with an independent decoder (inverse zigzag walk + real Reed-Solomon syndrome check, not a re-run of the encoder) in bot/test/wave5-local-service-whatsapp-qr.test.js, plus cross-checked externally with cv2.QRCodeDetector and zbarimg during development. The task description said this was 'fixed by an earlier wave' — it was not, on this worktree's branch point; see report for detail.

LS-02.title: Add/remove for services, portfolio categories and certifications was disconnected from the UI
LS-02.notes: templates/local-service/script.js now builds its own add/+/remove-x UI for services, trust ("De ce noi"), portfolio categories and certifications, talking the same postMessage protocol builder/app.js already handles unconditionally. New items are seeded with real Romanian placeholder text (never a literal 'New item'). A gap in builder/edit-overlay.js (SAFE_LIST_PATHS omits certifications/trust; its container-detection also mis-targets local-service's single-field service items) is documented precisely in HANDOFF-local-service.md rather than edited, per the file-ownership rules for this wave.

LS-03.title: Duplicate, unsynced Instagram URL fields (Contact section vs Instagram section)
LS-03.notes: Out of scope for this wave's explicit task list (services/CLS/a11y); left as a known open item. Would need contact.instagram.url and instagram.url unified to one schema field or synced on save (the latter needs builder/app.js).

audit-mediums-31-32.title: IG/FB footer links under 24x24px target size; brand-colour text on dark backgrounds under WCAG AA contrast
audit-mediums-31-32.notes: IG/FB are now real SVG icons in 44x44 anchors (matches professionals/desserdirina's existing pattern); WhatsApp's footer icon anchor grew from 18x23 to 44x44 too. .ls-meter__n and .ls-punch__n::before now use color-mix(in srgb, var(--cta) 50%, white) instead of the raw owner-chosen accent, verified to hold >=4.5:1 for the default preset's navy accent, orange, and a synthetic near-black worst case.

additional-a11y-found-this-wave.title: Horizontal overflow at 200% browser zoom (mobile 390) — pre-existing, not in the original audit
additional-a11y-found-this-wave.notes: CSS grid blowout: .ls-about had no explicit grid-template-columns on mobile, so the single implicit column grew to the .ls-lead contact card's min-content width (long unbroken phone-number text) instead of clamping to the viewport. Fixed with grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) plus min-width:0 on the flex rows inside. Confirmed present on git HEAD before this change (474px scrollWidth vs 390px viewport) and fixed after (390 == 390).

performance-CLS.title: CLS 0.20 desktop / 0.17 mobile per the performance lens
performance-CLS.status: measured — already effectively zero for this template; hardened logo images defensively
performance-CLS.notes: Real PerformanceObserver layout-shift measurement on templates/local-service's own published live site (default preset, both viewports) shows CLS ~0.0000009-0.000007 both BEFORE and AFTER this wave's changes — the audit's 0.20/0.17 figures were measured on a different, shared performance run (its own evidence names a 'Casa Nord' / product-menu site) and generalized to the whole product rather than re-verified per template. The two photo grids (.ls-shot img, .ls-igcell img) already carried CSS aspect-ratio before this wave. The one real gap closed here: .ls-hero__logo and .ls-foot__logo (schema.json's 'logo' field has no stored width/height) had no aspect-ratio/width/height at all — hardened with aspect-ratio: 3/1 + object-fit: contain as defense-in-depth for the owner-upload-a-logo path, which the default preset doesn't exercise.
